-- T3c (ii): a handle from one `seal` read inside another.
module Test.ElabScope.Cross (crossed) where

import Prelude
import Features.Check.Generate.Elab (readType, seal)
import Features.Check.Generate.Gen (fresh)
import Test.ElabScope.Common (header, minted, site)

crossed = seal header (map outer (fresh minted))
  where
  outer handle = pure (seal header (pure (readType site handle)))
